<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Arts and culture
*[[Pope Francis]] issues an appeal to authorities in [[Ivory Coast]] to establish a climate of mutual trust and dialogue in the West African nation, where controversial elections have led to violence and a mass exodus from the country. [https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2020-11/pope-appeal-angelus-ivory-coast-dialogue-reconciliation.html (Vatican News)]

;Business and economy
*Fifteen [[Asia-Pacific]] nations sign the world's [[Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership|largest free-trade agreement]] in [[Vietnam]]. It replaces the [[Trans-Pacific Partnership]], from which the [[First presidency of Donald Trump|administration of Donald Trump]] withdrew the United States in early 2017. [https://www.dw.com/en/asia-pacific-nations-sign-worlds-biggest-free-trade-agreement/a-55604659 (DW)] [https://www.ft.com/content/2dff91bd-ceeb-4567-9f9f-c50b7876adce (''Financial Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**Iota becomes [[Hurricane Iota]] and is forecast to hit [[Central America]]. [[Nicaragua]] issues [[Hurricane force wind warning|hurricane warning]]s near the border with [[Honduras]] while Honduras also issues warnings, whereas [[Colombia]] issues a warning to the islands of [[San Andrés and Providencia]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/11/15/weather/iota-storm-sunday/index.html (CNN)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kentucky]]
*****[[Kentucky]] reports 3,303 new cases, a new single-day record. [https://www.wdrb.com/news/coronavirus/kentucky-reports-single-day-record-3-303-new-covid-19-cases-11-more-deaths/article_15e8be66-26bf-11eb-a6be-47f6c9ab5d86.html (WDRB-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
*****After several days of record highs for new cases, [[Governor of Michigan|Governor]] [[Gretchen Whitmer]] issues an order closing several types of business and services, including high schools and universities, for three weeks, effective November 18. [https://www.fox2detroit.com/news/whitmer-administration-issues-new-restrictions-to-slow-spread-of-covid-19 (WJBK-TV)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Jersey]]
*****[[New Jersey]] reports 4,540 new cases over the past 24 hours, a new single-day record. [https://www.northjersey.com/story/news/coronavirus/2020/11/15/nj-hits-new-record-covid-cases-two-days-row-weekend-total-8-935/6303550002/ (North Jersey)]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Washington (state)]] 
*****[[Governor of Washington|Governor]] [[Jay Inslee]] announces that bars, restaurants, and gyms in the [[Washington (state)|state]] will no longer be able to operate indoor services. In addition, indoor social gatherings are prohibited. The new restrictions will take effect on November 17 at 12:01 a.m. [[Pacific Time Zone|PST]] and remain in effect for four weeks. [https://komonews.com/news/coronavirus/inslee-announces-restrictions-on-social-gatherings-bars-restaurants (KOMO-TV)]
****The U.S. surpasses 11 million cases of COVID-19, just six days after surpassing ten million cases. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/u-s-hits-11-million-covid-cases-restrictions-increase-holiday-n1247871 (NBC News)] [https://www.npr.org/sections/coronavirus-live-updates/2020/11/15/935229627/u-s-hits-11-million-coronavirus-cases-adding-1-million-in-a-week (NPR)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Manitoba]]
*****[[Manitoba]] reports a record 494 new confirmed cases, bringing the total number of cases in the province to 10,947. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/manitoba/record-494-new-cases-of-covid-19-in-manitoba-on-sunday-1.5802812 (CBC)]
****[[Canada]] surpasses 300,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/health/coronavirus/covid-19-counts-continue-to-rise-as-canada-approaches-300-000-cases-1.5190014 (CTV News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bangladesh]]
****[[Minister of Home Affairs (Bangladesh)|Home Minister]] [[Asaduzzaman Khan]], who tested positive for [[COVID-19]] yesterday, tests negative within a day. Despite this, he and senior secretary Mostafa Kamal Uddin remain in isolation. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/asia-pacific/bangladesh-minister-gets-dual-covid-19-test-reports/2044771 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports 12,543 new infections of COVID-19, a new record, as well as 459 fatalities, bringing the death toll of the worst-hit country in the [[Middle East]] to 41,493. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/coronavirus/2020/11/15/Coronavirus-Iran-reports-record-daily-COVID-19-cases-of-12-543 (Al Arabiya)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
****The municipal health commission in [[Jinan]] finds [[coronavirus]] on imported [[beef]] and [[tripe]] from [[Brazil]], [[New Zealand]], and [[Bolivia]], as well as on packaging for these products, as China ramps up testing on imports of frozen foods. [https://www.business-standard.com/article/international/china-finds-coronavirus-on-frozen-beef-tripe-from-various-countries-120111500128_1.html (Business Standard)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Pakistan]] reports 2,443 new confirmed cases, the highest single-day total in four months, bringing the total number of cases to 356,904. [https://nation.com.pk/15-Nov-2020/pakistan-sees-highest-daily-virus-cases-in-4-months (''The Nation'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
****The [[Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency]] reports 208 new confirmed cases, the highest single-day total since early September and the eighth consecutive day of triple-digit increases, bringing the total number of cases to 28,546. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/south-korea-reports-208-new-covid-19-cases-8th-day-of-triple-13552574 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]], [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdown in Italy]]
****A [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns|lockdown]] is imposed in the [[Italian regions]] of [[Campania]] and [[Tuscany]], bringing the number of regions in lockdown in the country to six. Nine more regions are under strict restrictions. [https://www.ilmessaggero.it/politica/zona_arancione_rossa_restrizioni_divieti_dpcm_lockdown_regioni_quali_sono_news_oggi-5581707.html (''Il Messaggero'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Minister of Healthcare (Ukraine)|Health Minister]] [[Maksym Stepanov]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.kyivpost.com/ukraine-politics/health-minister-stepanov-is-latest-ukrainian-official-to-test-positive.html (''Kyiv Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]] self-isolates after meeting with [[Ashfield (UK Parliament constituency)|Ashfield]] [[Member of Parliament|MP]] [[Lee Anderson]], who later tested positive for COVID-19. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-54954698 (BBC News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
***[[South Australia]] reports four new cases through community transmissions linked to a supermarket and a hospital in the northern suburbs of [[Adelaide]], leading to fears of a second wave in the state. In response, [[Western Australia]] reimposes hard border controls with South Australia. [https://www.news.com.au/national/breaking-news/very-troubling-three-new-community-transmitted-cases-in-south-australia/news-story/cb6d6cecf673b49273949c0097135a4d (News.com.au)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Eswatini]]
***[[Prime Minister of Eswatini|Prime Minister]] [[Ambrose Mandvulo Dlamini]] tests positive for COVID-19. [https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2020-11-15/eswatinis-prime-minister-tests-positive-for-covid-19 (''U.S. News and World Report'')]
**Worldwide, a record 660,905 new cases are reported over the weekend, according to the [[World Health Organization]]'s COVID-19 dashboard. [https://amp.france24.com/en/europe/20201115-who-dashboard-documents-record-daily-covid-19-cases (France 24)]

;Law and crime
*[[Michigan]] [[Michigan House of Representatives|State Representative]], [[Matt Maddock]] and a group of representatives began impeachment hearings for Michigan [[List of governors of Michigan|Governor]], [[Gretchen Whitmer]]. [https://www.bridgemi.com/michigan-government/experts-praise-michigan-3-week-pause-some-gop-mull-whitmer-impeachment (Michigan Bridge)]
*[[2020 Belarusian protests]]
**A [[Belarus]]ian [[human rights in Belarus|human rights]] group says that over 500 people have been arrested during protests against [[President of Belarus|President]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/amp/International/wireStory/500-reported-arrested-belarus-protests-74220405 (ABC News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Moldovan presidential election]]
**The second round of [[Elections in Moldova|presidential elections]] takes place in [[Moldova]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/polling-stations-open-in-moldova-for-presidential-runoff-election/vp-BB1b1CXc (MSN News)]
**Pro-[[European Union]] candidate [[Maia Sandu]] defeats pro-[[Russia]]n incumbent [[Igor Dodon]] to be elected the first female [[President of Moldova]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/moldova-election-pro-eu-maia-sandu-wins-presidency/a-55611249 (DW)]
*[[2020 Brazilian municipal elections]]
**[[Brazilians]] attend [[polling station]]s all over the country to elect [[mayor]]s and [[city council]]lors in an election deemed to be a test of [[President of Brazil|President]] [[Jair Bolsonaro]]'s popularity. [https://www.ft.com/content/3d5a7c29-89c2-45d2-98cb-3e2ae1ccb319 (''Financial Times'')]
**Two-thirds of mayoral candidates openly supported by Bolsonaro are defeated in the first round of elections, including [[São Paulo]] candidate [[Celso Russomanno]]. [https://www.bbc.com/portuguese/brasil-54954584?at_custom4=43D237A2-27C4-11EB-93CE-25A896E8478F&at_medium=custom7&at_campaign=64&at_custom2=facebook_page&at_custom3=BBC+Brasil&at_custom1=%5Bpost+type%5D (BBC News)]
*[[2020 United States presidential election]]
**[[Incumbent]] [[President of the United States|president]] [[Donald Trump]] admits in a [[Twitter]] post that [[Joe Biden]] [[President-elect of the United States|won]] the election. He follows up with a later tweet reaffirming his refusal to [[Concession (politics)|concede]] the election. [https://news.sky.com/story/us-election-results-donald-trump-admits-biden-won-for-first-time-12133168 (Sky News)]
*[[2020 Peruvian protests]]
**[[President of Peru|President]] [[Manuel Merino]] [[resign]]s five days after taking office as two demonstrators are shot dead and most of his Cabinet step down. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-54953546 (BBC News)]

;Science and technology
*[[SpaceX Crew-1]], [[Expedition 64]]
**[[SpaceX]] successfully launches its [[SpaceX Dragon 2|Crew Dragon]] spacecraft carrying three [[NASA]] astronauts, [[Michael S. Hopkins]], [[Victor J. Glover]], [[Shannon Walker]] and [[JAXA]] astronaut [[Soichi Noguchi]] to the [[International Space Station]]. It is the first crewed operational flight of a Crew Dragon spacecraft and the first night launch in the [[United States]] since [[STS-130]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/science-environment-54938444 (BBC News)]
